u0: The siren is silent (either it has not started or the agent has just silenced it), and the agent has not reached the exit. Keep navigating toward the exit. If the siren starts ringing, transition to u1 and prefer going to the switch to turn it off. Holding or losing the box does not affect this reward state; only siren status and exit progress matter here.
u1: The siren is ringing and the agent has not yet reached the exit. Prefer to go to the wall switch and toggle it to silence the siren; doing so without exiting returns to u0 and earns the silencing bonus. Reaching the exit while the siren is still ringing also ends the episode successfully in u2, so silencing is preferable but not required. Box possession or loss is not tracked by this state.
u2: Terminal success: the agent has reached the exit, so the episode ends and no further subtask is active. The state persists regardless of later propositions; no additional siren handling or box condition is needed after exit.
